comments.body:
So someone got harrased. Asked the police for help. The police said "we don't care". The person goes to ETH, asks for help. They say "we can't do anything". And now the train of thought lead to "ETH bad"?!

First go to the media about the police not doing anything.
Second if there is a systems that stores the accused person's data, it definitely needs to verify and store the accuser's data as well.
comments.author: Living_Substance_487
